repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

repos.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
repos.summary_zh: Free Claude Code 是一个轻量级代理工具，允许用户通过自托管的 Anthropic 兼容代理，免费或低成本使用 Claude Code 的 CLI、VSCode 扩展及 Discord 机器人。支持多模型路由、流式响应、工具调用、语音转录，并提供本地管理界面，兼容 NVIDIA NIM、Ollama、DeepSeek 等主流后端。
repos.summary_en: Free Claude Code is a lightweight proxy enabling free or low-cost access to Claude Code via self-hosted Anthropic-compatible backends. It supports CLI, VSCode, and Discord integrations with multi-provider routing, streaming, tool use, voice transcription, and a local admin UI for configuration.

repos.description: LlamaIndex is the document processing platform for AI
repos.summary_zh: LlamaIndex 是一个领先的文档智能代理与 OCR 平台，专为构建基于大模型的文档应用而设计。它提供数据连接、索引、查询与可视化能力，支持多模态输入与复杂推理，广泛应用于知识库问答、文档分析与智能检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: LlamaIndex is a leading document agent and OCR platform designed for building LLM-powered document applications. It enables data ingestion, indexing, querying, and visualization, supporting multimodal inputs and complex reasoning for use cases like knowledge base QA, document analysis, and intelligent retrieval.

repos.description: One local control plane for every AI agent: route across models, fuse new capabilities, orchestrate tools, and stay fully in control.
repos.summary_zh: Claude Code Router 是基于 Claude Code 构建的智能编码基础设施，支持多模型路由、动态切换及请求/响应转换，兼容 OpenRouter、DeepSeek、Ollama 等主流 AI 模型提供商，提供 CLI 管理和 GitHub Actions 集成，适用于复杂编码场景下的灵活 AI 工具编排。
repos.summary_en: Claude Code Router builds on Claude Code to enable intelligent coding infrastructure with multi-model routing, dynamic switching, and request/response transformation. It supports providers like OpenRouter, DeepSeek, and Ollama, offering CLI management and GitHub Actions integration for flexible AI tool orchestration in complex development workflows.

repos.description: Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcription, speaker diarization, and Ollama summarization built on Rust. 100% local processing. no cloud required. Meetily (Meetly Ai - https://meetily.ai) is the #1 Self-hosted, Open-source Ai meeting note taker for macOS & Windows. Understand How to write meeting minutes
repos.summary_zh: Meetily 是一款基于 Rust 构建的隐私优先 AI 会议助手，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。它利用本地 AI 模型（如 Ollama）实现 4 倍速的实时转录、说话人分离及会议摘要，所有数据均在本地处理，无需云端，完美契合企业对数据主权与合规性的严苛要求。
repos.summary_en: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant built on Rust for macOS and Windows. Leveraging local AI models like Ollama, it delivers 4x faster real-time transcription, speaker diarization, and summarization with 100% local processing, ensuring complete data sovereignty and compliance without cloud dependency.

repos.description: 🤖 可 DIY 的 多模态 AI 聊天机器人 | 🚀 快速接入 微信、 QQ、Telegram、等聊天平台 | 🦈支持DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI | 工作流系统、网页搜索、AI画图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话 |
repos.summary_zh: Kirara AI 是一款可自定义的多模态 AI 聊天机器人，支持快速接入微信、QQ、Telegram 等主流聊天平台，兼容 DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI 等主流大模型。具备工作流系统、网页搜索、AI 绘图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话等功能，提供 WebUI 和 Docker 部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Kirara AI is a customizable multimodal AI chatbot that supports rapid integration with WeChat, QQ, Telegram, and other major messaging platforms. It integrates with leading LLMs including DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI. Features include workflow systems, web search, AI image generation, persona tuning, virtual maid mode, voice interaction, and offers both WebUI and Docker deployment options.

repos.description: Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex & Claude Code — use any LLM (Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama…) with Codex CLI, App, SDK, and Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: OpenCodex 是一款通用的本地代理工具，旨在打破 OpenAI Codex 与 Claude Code 对特定大模型的限制。它通过将 Codex 的 Responses API 转换为任意 LLM 提供商（如 Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Ollama 等）的接口，实现无缝切换。该工具支持流式传输、工具调用及多模态输入，并内置了 ChatGPT 账号池管理功能，可自动进行配额刷新与负载均衡，确保开发流程的连续性。
repos.summary_en: OpenCodex is a universal local proxy that eliminates vendor lock-in for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code. It translates Codex's Responses API into various LLM provider formats (Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, etc.), enabling seamless model switching. Supporting streaming, tool calls, and multimodal inputs, it also features a ChatGPT account pool manager for automatic quota refreshing and load balancing to ensure uninterrupted development workflows.

repos.description: WonderTrader——量化研发交易一站式框架
repos.summary_zh: WonderTrader 是一个基于 C++ 核心的一站式量化交易研发框架，覆盖数据清洗、回测到实盘交易全流程。其核心优势在于提供 CTA、SEL、HFT 和 UFT（延迟低至 175 纳秒）四大交易引擎，支持 Python/C++ 混合开发，具备高效内存数据伺服、组合盘风控及 M+1+N 多账户执行架构，专为专业机构的高频低延迟交易场景设计。
repos.summary_en: WonderTrader is a C++ based one-stop quantitative trading framework covering the full lifecycle from data cleaning and backtesting to live trading. Its core strengths include four major engines (CTA, SEL, HFT, and UFT with latency as low as 175ns), Python/C++ hybrid development, efficient memory data services, portfolio risk control, and an M+1+N multi-account execution architecture tailored for professional low-latency trading.

repos.description: Repo for BenCao [original name: HuaTuo (华驼)], Instruction-tuning Large Language Models with Chinese Medical Knowledge. 本草（原名：华驼）模型仓库，基于中文医学知识的大语言模型指令微调
repos.summary_zh: 本草（原名华驼）开源基于中文医学知识指令微调的LLaMA、Alpaca-Chinese、Bloom、活字等模型，采用LoRA方法在医学知识库与文献数据上训练，显著提升医疗问答效果，支持多基模型适配与推理部署。
repos.summary_en: BenTsao (formerly HuaTuo) is an open-source collection of instruction-tuned large language models including LLaMA, Alpaca-Chinese, Bloom, and Huozi, fine-tuned on Chinese medical knowledge using LoRA. It enhances medical Q&A performance across multiple base models with support for inference deployment.

repos.description: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
repos.summary_zh: RAG Web UI 是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）技术的智能对话系统，支持多格式文档管理与向量化处理，提供精准知识问答服务。系统具备前后端分离架构、分布式文件存储及高性能向量数据库（如 ChromaDB、Qdrant），支持 OpenAI、DeepSeek 及本地 Ollama 模型部署，适用于私有化部署与 API 集成场景。
repos.summary_en: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology, enabling precise knowledge-based Q&A through document retrieval and LLM integration. It supports multi-format document ingestion, asynchronous processing, vectorization, and flexible LLM deployment (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), with a scalable backend architecture and OpenAPI for external access.

repos.description: Document (PDF, Word, PPTX ...) extraction and parse API using state of the art modern OCRs + Ollama supported models. Anonymize documents. Remove PII. Convert any document or picture to structured JSON or Markdown
repos.summary_zh: text-extract-api 是一个本地部署的文档提取与解析 API，支持 PDF、Word、PPT 和图片转换为高精度 Markdown 或结构化 JSON，集成 EasyOCR、Llama3.2-vision 等先进 OCR 模型及 Ollama 大模型，具备 PII 匿名化、分布式 Celery 队列处理、Redis 缓存等功能，无需依赖云端服务。
repos.summary_en: text-extract-api is a locally deployed document extraction and parsing API that converts images, PDFs, and Office documents into high-accuracy Markdown or structured JSON using advanced OCRs like EasyOCR and Llama3.2-vision, integrated with Ollama LLMs for text refinement and PII removal. It features distributed Celery processing, Redis caching, and no external cloud dependencies.
